verdict.rationale: Users choose which MCP servers and skills to add from the Settings Library, which controls the agent's external tools. Write commands ask once per session, destructive commands always ask, and a composer toggle switches between asking and allowing every tool call. That is coarse, per-user control rather than granular governance. Missing for 10: per-tool or per-integration allow/deny lists, team or org-level policy enforcement an engineering lead could apply across users, detailed permission docs, and independent corroboration.
